chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"Prostration is upon what the earth produces, except that which is eaten or worn."

key_terms.أَنْبَتَتِ: that which it caused to grow or produce
key_terms.لُبِسَ: that which is worn as clothing

ai.seo_question: What materials are permissible for prostration in prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about the valid material for sajdah. It states that prostration should be on what grows from the earth, excluding items that are normally eaten or used as clothing.
